q133.question: What is the physical scale of the four outer space levels in which the Corps of the Finality will take part in the future, and what is the reality of "God the Ultimate," who functions on the absonite level?
q133.answer:
The specific details given in the Urantia revelation concerning the physical scale of the four outer space levels and the reality of "God the Ultimate," who functions on the absonite level, are as follows.

1. The Physical Scale of the Four Outer Space Levels

The universe of mankind, which at present has inhabitants and is clothed with administrative organization, is the grand universe made up of the seven superuniverses. But beyond the outer boundary of the grand universe, four incomparably vast outer space levels unfold in successive stages, preparing for the universe ages of the future.

The space zone of relative quiet (the interspace zone):

Between the outermost boundary of the seven superuniverses and the first outer space level there lies, as a buffer zone, a comparatively quiet space zone, averaging about four hundred thousand light-years in width, free of star dust or cosmic fog.

The first outer space level:

Beginning about half a million light-years beyond the periphery of the grand universe, a stupendous belt of energy wheels, increasing in volume and intensity, stretches over a width of more than twenty-five million light-years.

Here physical universes are in process of organization on such a scale that some 375 million new galaxies will be observable in the not-too-distant future.

Already at least seventy thousand aggregations of galactic matter, each larger than any one present superuniverse, are being formed in clusters.

The second, third, and fourth outer space levels:

More than fifty million light-years beyond the first space level, evidences of the material creation of the second outer space level are detected, and toward the third and fourth space levels space becomes ever deeper and vaster.

For these unknown outer universes, of the 28,011 Architects of the Master Universe, 70 are in charge of the first level, 490 of the second, 3,430 of the third, and 24,010 of the fourth, and they are drawing up stupendous space plans.

Alternating rotation and enormous quantities of matter:

The galaxies of the first outer space level revolve clockwise, opposite to the grand universe (counterclockwise); the second space level revolves counterclockwise, and the third again clockwise, thereby adjusting space tension and gravity.

The total mass of force and matter assembling in these four outer space levels amounts to tens or even hundreds of times the mass of matter contained in all the seven superuniverses today.

2. The Reality of "God the Ultimate," Who Functions on the Absonite Level

God the Ultimate is the second experiential Deity personality, emerging on the absonite level, a level of transcended time and transcended space beyond the finite dimension of time and space.

The second level of experiential Deity:

Whereas the Paradise Father, Son, and Spirit are existential Deity, the first experiential Deity, embracing the evolutionary finite level of time and space, is the Supreme Being (God the Supreme), and the second experiential Deity, unifying the absonite values of the master universe that transcend time and space, is God the Ultimate.

Relation to the Ultimate Trinity:

God the Ultimate is empowered and personalized as the result of the unification of the Ultimate Trinity, the first experiential Trinity.

The Ultimate Trinity is composed of the union of the Supreme Being, the Supreme Creator Personalities (the Creator Sons, the Ancients of Days, and others), and the Architects of the Master Universe.

Attributes and universe role:

God the Ultimate is God as spiritually recognized as a person by absonite beings (absoniters / Transcendentalers).

As the transcendental almighty, all-knowing, and ever-present One of the whole vast master universe beyond the grand universe (the seven superuniverses plus the four outer space levels), he exercises absonite overcontrol of space-energy and spirit-mind.

Not having existed from past eternity, but as a Deity emerging through the experience of historic universe origins, he has a personality beginning but exists eternally without end.

Connection with the future destiny of ascending mortals (finaliters):

When a mortal has ascended to Paradise, found the Universal Father, and become a member of the Corps of the Finality, and then is advanced to the seventh stage of spirit to teach and govern the new intelligent beings of outer space in the ages to come, God the Ultimate will be the universe God whom they newly discover and experience.

q134.question: What is the status of the "seventh stage of spirit" that the finaliters will receive when they go forth into outer space, and what is the final mystery of the "Absolute Trinity" that will unfold after the master universe is completed?
q134.answer:
The specific details concerning the spiritual status of the "seventh stage of spirit" that the finaliters will receive when they go forth into unknown outer space, and the final mystery of the "Absolute Trinity" that will unfold after the whole master universe has been completed, are as follows.

1. The Spiritual Status of the Seventh Stage of Spirit

The status in the present universe age (sixth-stage spirit): When an ascending mortal has reached Paradise, completed the Trinity oath of eternity, and been mustered into the Corps of the Finality, he remains in the status of a sixth-stage spirit during the present universe age [31:3.3-3.4]. This means that, as a finite creature, he has reached the standard of perfection, but he has not yet arrived at the finality of spiritual attainment and universe service; it is a state still incomplete [31:3.6].

The time of promotion to seventh-stage spirit: As the future universe age advances, in which the universes of the vast outer space beyond the seven superuniverses (the first through fourth outer space levels) are fully organized physically and pioneered, the finaliters will at last be promoted to the "seventh stage of spirit" and take up their true eternal mission [31:3.5].

Five key universe qualities of seventh-stage spirit status:

Directly finding God the Supreme: In the status of sixth-stage spirit one is aware of the spiritual reality of the Supreme Being only conceptually, but as a seventh-stage spirit one at last achieves the highest attainment of finding God the Supreme in person and meeting him fully in spirit [56:6.4], [117:6.18].

The complete integration of the Adjuster heritage and the Supreme heritage: The heritage of the Thought Adjuster (divinity), a fragment of the Universal Father of Paradise, and the universe heritage of Mother Supreme (finite experience) come into perfect accord, establishing a universe selfhood able to represent the Father and the Mother of universes and personalities [117:6.7].

The mature union of a threefold mind: Following the fusion of the human mind of earthly days with the divine mind of the indwelling Adjuster, there is at last a union with the experiential mind of the actualized Supreme Being, through which one gains incomparable universe wisdom and integrated insight [117:5.3].

Spiritual teachers and administrators for the creatures of the outer universes: To the new living beings of outer space, who will appear without having passed directly through the evolutionary adversities and trials of time and space, they will serve as teachers and administrative rulers, passing on the know-how by which they triumphed over finite trials and fully compensating for these beings' experiential deficiency [31:10.13], [117:2.6].

Field assignment with Ascendington as the permanent home: On becoming seventh-stage spirits, they will give up their residential status on Paradise and, keeping Ascendington as their eternal home address of sentimental memories and reminiscent recollections, will be permanently assigned to the field of outer space [13:2.1].

2. The Final Mystery of the "Absolute Trinity" That Will Unfold After the Whole Master Universe Is Completed

Following the existential Paradise Trinity (Father, Son, and Spirit) and the first experiential Trinity, the Ultimate Trinity (the Supreme Creators, the Supreme Being, and the Architects of the Master Universe), when the development of the whole master universe (the seven superuniverses plus the four outer space levels) is completed, the second experiential Trinity, the "Absolute Trinity," will be formed and will come into full operation [0:12.7], [106:3.2], [106:5.1].

The composition and final mystery of the Absolute Trinity:

Its three members:

God the Supreme: the experiential Deity unifying the divinity of the grand universe of finite time and space [0:12.7], [106:5.1].

God the Ultimate: the experiential Deity unifying the transcendental, absonite divinity of the whole master universe [0:12.7], [106:5.1].

The unrevealed Consummator of Universe Destiny: the mysterious divine being in charge of the final execution of all experiential universe destiny [0:12.7], [106:5.1].

The experiential personalization of God the Absolute: The complete function of the Absolute Trinity will at last bring about the experiential personalization, as "God the Absolute," of the Deity Absolute, which until then has been enshrouded only in existential potentiality [0:10.1], [106:6.5].

The eternal unification of the three Absolutes: The three great Absolutes, the Deity Absolute, the Universal Absolute, and the Unqualified Absolute, are joined to accomplish the absolute actualization of all potentiality and actuality [106:6.1-6.6].

The completion of the Trinity of Trinities: The Paradise Trinity, the Ultimate Trinity, and the Absolute Trinity are integrated into one, forming the "Trinity of Trinities" on the third level [106:8.1-8.8].

The eternal return to the Father-Infinite: In this way the I AM, who before the beginning of eternity differentiated himself and began the history of creation, together with the countless sons who have achieved ascension, completes the majestic cycle of attaining the most perfect eternal self-realization as the "Father-Infinite" [106:8.22].

q135.question: What is the endless eternal growth that mortal ascenders will experience even after the "Trinity of Trinities" has been completed?
q135.answer:
Even after the final completion of the "Trinity of Trinities," in which all the infinite potentials of the universe are fully actualized, the eternal growth that mortal ascenders will experience will never stop or be exhausted [106:7.5].

The endless growth of the eternal future and the eternal destiny of mortal ascenders, as conveyed by the Urantia revelation, unfold in the following dimensions.

1. "⟦Q 106:7.5⟧La recherche de Dieu n’a pas de fin !⟦/Q⟧" (The Continuation of Infinite Exploration)

The inexhaustible depth of the Father-Infinite: Even if a mortal ascender attains both the Supreme of the finite (time-space) dimension and the Ultimate of the absonite dimension and arrives at the level of the Trinity of Trinities, the unrevealed infinity of the Universal Father can never be exhausted [106:7.5].

The joy of endless discovery of divinity: No matter how much an ascending being comes to know God and become like him, there will always remain deeper divine aspects of him beyond human imagining [106:7.5]. Therefore "⟦Q 106:7.5⟧La recherche de Dieu n’a pas de fin !⟦/Q⟧," and this is not a discouragement to mortals but the supreme assurance of eternal growth [106:7.5-7.6].

2. Eternal Expansion into the Cosmos-Infinite

A beginning beyond new limits: Even when the very remote eternal moment comes in which the whole master universe (the grand universe plus the four outer space levels) is fully completed, the ascended finaliters will look back on that majestic history as merely the first beginning toward a greater and unknown infinity [106:7.8].

Entering the stage of the absolute dimension: Having completed growth in the finite and the absonite, the finaliters will go forth into the transultimate arena of the "Cosmos-Infinite" that stretches beyond the master universe, and will take up the eternal creative task of experientially unifying all the possibilities of eternal actuality and potentiality [106:6.3], [106:7.4].

3. Self-Realization as the "⟦Q 106:8.23⟧Final Sons of the Absolute Father⟦/Q⟧"

The status of volitional participants in divinity: Mortal ascenders who have achieved self-realization in the eternal cycles of infinity go beyond being mere creatures and become volitional participants in the eternal self-revelation of the Universal Father, final sons of the absolute Father [106:8.22].

A perfect personal brotherhood and divine unity: The experiential assets of the mortal who rose from the lowest depths of time and the divine heritage of the indwelling Thought Adjuster are completely fused, so that he stands forever as a perfect universe self who radiates divine love, truth, and beauty throughout the grand universe and all of outer space [106:9.11-9.12].

4. The Universe Law of Eternal Growth

Growth never comes to a standstill: Statics in growth can never appear in the total cosmos, because the actuals that are the basis of growth are unqualified and the potentials that are the possibilities of growth are unlimited [115:3.17].

The eternal passport of doing the will of God: For an ascending personality the eternal passport is always "⟦Q 106:9.11⟧living the will of God⟦/Q⟧" [106:9.11]. Each time one chooses and does the will of God, not only is a new universe reality born, but new capacities for personality growth keep opening throughout eternity [115:3.16].

In summary, even though mortal man starts from the lowly and humble beginning of the earth, rises to the Paradise summit of eternity, and passes through the ultimate age of the Trinity of Trinities, the eternal exploration in search of the Creator Father and the adventure of divine service never end but go on as an eternal festival [106:7.5], [106:9.11].

q136.question: Please summarize the causes, the course, and the results of the Lucifer rebellion.
q136.answer:
The causes, course, and results of the Lucifer rebellion as presented in The Urantia Book can be summarized as follows.

1. The Causes of the Lucifer Rebellion

The Lucifer rebellion was started by Lucifer, a primary Lanonandek Son who was the sovereign of the system of Satania, which belongs to the local universe of Nebadon in the superuniverse of Orvonton, together with his first assistant, Satan.

The inner cause (pride and self-contemplation): Lucifer was a being of outstanding wisdom and brilliance, but he fell into self-contemplation and personal pride, abandoned his universe loyalty, and was carried away by the sophistry of personal liberty.

The three main claims of the "Lucifer Declaration of Liberty":

Denial of the reality of the Universal Father: He claimed that the Universal Father did not really exist and was merely a myth invented by the Paradise Sons to maintain their rule of the universe.

Rejection of Michael's universe government: Demanding complete self-government for the local systems, he denounced as tyranny the universe sovereignty of the Creator Son Michael and the judicial jurisdiction of the superuniverse rulers (the Ancients of Days).

Attack on the mortal ascension plan: He attacked the universal plan of training ascending mortals and leading them to Paradise as unethical, a waste of time, and a program that unjustly held mortals in subjection.

2. The Course of the Lucifer Rebellion

The proclamation and spread of the rebellion: About two hundred thousand years ago, as Urantia reckons time, the rebellion formally broke out when the Lucifer manifesto was proclaimed at the annual conclave of Satania on Jerusem.

Of the 607 inhabited worlds of the system of Satania, thirty-seven Planetary Princes joined the rebellion, and Caligastia, the Planetary Prince of Urantia, together with his chief of staff, Abaddon, also took part in the betrayal.

Of the one hundred corporeal members of the Prince's staff on Urantia, only forty, including Van and Amadon, remained loyal to the universe government, while sixty went over to the side of the rebellion.

About a third of the administrator seraphim, 95 per cent of the Material Sons, and many of the disloyal midway creatures were deceived, but of the ascending mortal citizens of Jerusem (about 187 million), not a single one joined; every one of them remained loyal.

The "war in heaven" and the response:

Because the Creator Son Michael had not yet completed his human bestowal life, he did not immediately crush the rebellion by force; respecting the free-will choice of the creatures, he adopted a merciful policy of delay that gave time for repentance.

Gabriel set up the banner of Michael on Jerusem and, leading the loyal forces of Satania, opposed the rebels not by physical conflict but by a contest between truth and sophistry (the "war in heaven").

3. The Results of the Lucifer Rebellion

Spiritual isolation (quarantine): The thirty-seven worlds where the rebellion took place and the system of Satania were immediately cut off from the whole constellation and from the universe communication circuits and were spiritually isolated.

The tragic retardation of Urantia's civilization: On Urantia, because of the betrayal of the Planetary Prince Caligastia, the culture of Dalamatia was destroyed and the plans for racial improvement and spiritual development came completely to nothing, so that the planet suffered long ages of confusion and retrogression.

Jesus' victory of the cross and the effective end of the rebellion:

Christ Michael (Jesus) was bestowed on Urantia as a mortal man and completely overcame the final temptations and assaults of Lucifer and Satan.

With this Michael established his unqualified sovereignty over Nebadon, and the nominal authority and status of the rebel leaders came to an end forever.

The internment and expected final extinction of the archrebels:

The leaders of the rebellion, such as Lucifer, Satan, and Caligastia, together with the unrepentant disloyal beings, have been interned on the spiritual prison worlds near Jerusem.

As soon as the final verdict in the case of Gabriel vs. Lucifer comes from the superuniverse court of Orvonton (the Ancients of Days), they are to be completely annihilated from the universe (the extinction of existence) and "become as though they had not been."

Conversion into universe good: The mortals (such as Amadon) and celestial beings who remained loyal to the end through the ordeal were greatly strengthened in universe faith and character, and as a result far greater spiritual benefits and rewards have accrued to the whole universe than the evil caused by the rebellion.

q137.question: Please compare the similarities and differences between the Urantia Book's account of the Lucifer rebellion and the Bible's account.
q137.answer:
The Lucifer rebellion described in The Urantia Book and the Bible's (traditional Christianity's) stories of the fallen angels and Satan share the common motif of a revolt by celestial beings and a spiritual war, but they differ precisely and fundamentally in the identity of the beings involved, the professed grounds of the rebellion, the nature of the war, and the way God (Michael) responds.

1. Main Similarities

Revolt and pride of a high celestial being:

Both accounts tell of a high celestial being, the most brilliant and gifted of creatures, who fell into self-contemplation, pride, and self-exaltation and rose up against the ruler of the universe [53:1.1], [53:1.3].

Use of the key figures and symbolic terms:

The main personal names and proper terms, such as "Lucifer," "Satan," "Michael," "Gabriel," "the dragon," and "the war in heaven," appear in both and play central roles [53:1.4], [53:1.6], [53:5.6].

Division and defection among celestial beings:

The structure is the same in that lower spiritual beings (about a third of the angelic hosts) were taken in by the deception and seduction of the rebel leader, sided with him, and fell along with him [53:7.6], [53:7.7].

Final defeat and the destiny of extinction at the hands of Jesus (Michael):

The pattern of the ending is the same: the rebel leaders were utterly defeated in their encounter with Jesus Christ, who came to earth, and lost their authority completely, and they face the destiny of eternal extinction (annihilation) through the final verdict of the universe courts [53:8.3-8.4], [53:9.7].

2. Main Differences

① The Identity and Rank of the Rebel Figures

The Bible (traditional Christianity):

Lucifer, Satan, the devil, the old serpent, the dragon, and so on are generally used interchangeably as alternative names or epithets for one and the same being (the fallen chief angel).

The Urantia Book:

It clearly distinguishes them as separate individual personalities of quite different origin and order.

Lucifer: a primary Lanonandek Son (System Sovereign) who ruled the 607 inhabited worlds of Satania [53:0.1], [53:1.1].

Satan: Lucifer's first assistant and a fellow Lanonandek Son [53:1.4].

The devil (Caligastia): Caligastia, the secondary Lanonandek Son who was the apostate Planetary Prince of Urantia (the earth) [53:1.4].

Beelzebub: the leader of the disloyal midway creatures who allied themselves with the forces of Caligastia [53:1.5].

The dragon: a name that symbolically designates the combined forces of all these rebel leaders [53:1.6].

② The Motive of the Rebellion and the Substance of Its Sophistry

The Bible (traditional Christianity):

It is portrayed as a vague and simplified pride, a mere lust for power in which Lucifer coveted the throne of God, saying, "⟦Q 43:4.6⟧I will be like the most High⟦/Q⟧" (Isaiah 14:14), along with the temptation of the fruit of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

The Urantia Book:

It sets out concretely the three great cosmic sophistries of the "⟦Q 53:3.1⟧Lucifer Declaration of Liberty⟦/Q⟧," which Lucifer carefully planned and announced [53:3.1-3.6]:

Denial of the reality of the Universal Father: he claimed that the Universal Father was only a myth invented by the Paradise Sons to maintain their rule, and that gravity and energy were self-acting [53:3.2].

Rejection of the local universe government and its jurisdiction: he denounced the sovereignty of Michael, the Creator Son, and the judicial jurisdiction of the superuniverse Ancients of Days as "tyranny" and demanded complete home rule for the system [53:3.3-3.4].

Attack on the mortal ascension plan: he criticized the ascension plan, which trains the human beings of time and space and leads them to Paradise, as unethical bondage and a waste of time [53:3.6].

③ The Nature of the "War in Heaven"

The Bible (traditional Christianity):

It is depicted as a physical and mythical armed battle in which Michael the archangel and his angels fought in heaven against the dragon and his angels and cast them down to the earth (Revelation 12:7-9).

The Urantia Book:

It was not a barbarous physical sword fight but a fierce spiritual and intellectual contest of ideas and truth, of sophistry and logic, waged in the amphitheater and the administrative districts of Jerusem [53:5.6].

It was a spiritual struggle in which Gabriel set up Michael's banner of three azure blue concentric circles and plainly exposed Lucifer's false propaganda with cosmic truth and defended the universe government [53:5.4], [53:5.6].

④ The Time Delay of Justice and Mercy (Why Satan Was Not Destroyed at Once)

The Bible (traditional Christianity):

Its theological explanation of why God does not destroy Satan immediately but leaves him for so long to tempt human beings on earth is somewhat vague.

The Urantia Book:

It sets forth in detail the many cosmic reasons and the wisdom behind the respect for free will and the time delay of mercy [54:3.1], [54:5.1-5.14]:

Since Michael had not yet completed his sevenfold bestowal and had not yet acquired full personal sovereignty, he did not arbitrarily use force against the will of creatures [53:5.2], [54:5.6].

Ample cosmic time for testing and maturing is needed, until the sinner either repents of his own accord or carries the way of evil to its conclusion and destroys himself completely [54:3.2], [54:4.3].

By openly exposing to the whole universe the process by which the rebellion destroys itself, the whole intelligent universe came to see for itself the hideousness and worthlessness of evil, and so the matter was transmuted so that the good resulting from the rebellion is more than a thousand times greater than the evil [54:5.9], [54:6.6].

⑤ Power over Human Beings (Mortals) and Influence on Them

The Bible (traditional Christianity):

Satan and the demons are portrayed as mighty evil beings who can invade the human mind and body, cause demoniacal possession, and forcibly dominate or tempt human beings.

The Urantia Book:

The supremacy of human free will: no fallen spirit can forcibly enter or manipulate the mind against a person's voluntary will [66:8.6], [77:7.7-7.8].

Complete protection since Pentecost: since Jesus' Pentecost, when the Spirit of Truth was poured out and the Thought Adjusters came to indwell all normal minds universally, the universe has been perfectly guarded so that no evil spirit can invade even the weakest human mind [53:8.7-8.8], [77:7.8].

The steadfastness of the ascending mortals: of the 187 million ascending mortals on Jerusem, not a single one was taken in or led astray by any of Lucifer's cunning sophistries; every one remained loyal [53:7.10], [53:7.12].

⑥ The Meaning of the Work of Jesus Christ

The Bible (traditional Christianity):

It emphasizes that Jesus died on the cross as a blood sacrifice (a ransom) to appease the wrath of God, in order to atone for sin and the power of Satan.

The Urantia Book:

Jesus came as Christ Michael, the Creator Son of the local universe of Nebadon, to complete his seventh bestowal as a mortal man [119:8.8], [120:0.1].

Through the temptations in the wilderness, the cross, and the resurrection, Michael submitted wholly to the will of the Paradise Father and thereby acquired unlimited sovereignty over Nebadon, and in this way he brought the rebellion of Lucifer, Satan, and Caligastia to a complete end, both technically and in fact [53:8.3-8.4], [134:8.9]. The cross is not a blood atonement but a revelation of the perfect love of God the Father [4:5.4], [186:5.7].

In summary, if the Bible's story of the devil and Satan is an archetypal record reflecting mankind's primitive fears and theological symbols, the Urantia Book's account of the Lucifer rebellion is a vast record of cosmic history that systematically and intelligently explains the structure of universe administration, free will, the evolution of personal character, and how divine mercy and justice work fairly throughout the whole universe [53:0.1], [54:6.1].

q138.question: Please tell me in detail about Lucifer's Declaration of Liberty.
q138.answer:
The "Lucifer Declaration of Liberty," recorded in Paper 53 of The Urantia Book, is the central platform and manifesto of the rebellion. It was officially proclaimed about two hundred thousand years ago, Urantia time, during the annual conclave held on the sea of glass on Jerusem, the headquarters of the system of Satania.

Lucifer and his first assistant Satan made self-assertion their battle cry, and Satan proclaimed that creatures were to give their allegiance only to Lucifer, the "⟦Q 53:4.1⟧friend of men and angels⟦/Q⟧" and the "God of liberty." The declaration consisted of the following three key points.

1. The Three Central Claims of the Lucifer Declaration of Liberty

① Denial of the Reality of the Universal Father

The myth claim: he claimed that the Universal Father did not really exist and was nothing but a myth invented by the Paradise Sons, who used the Father as a pretext to maintain their rule over the universes.

A self-sufficient cosmology: he held that physical gravity and space-energy were inherent in the universe itself, and he denied that the personality of creatures was a gift of the Father.

Attack on the finaliters: pointing out that the finaliters who had ascended to Paradise and returned could not clearly demonstrate the personality of the Universal Father, he charged that they were in collusion with the Paradise Sons to deceive the whole universe.

② Rejection of the Universe Government of the Creator Son (Michael) and of Superuniverse Jurisdiction

Demand for autonomy of the local system: he held that the local system (Satania) should be fully autonomous, and he denounced Michael's assuming sovereignty and requiring allegiance in the name of an unseen Father as a "⟦Q 53:3.3⟧clever scheme to aggrandize the Paradise Sons⟦/Q⟧."

Rejection of outside authorities: he condemned the superuniverse rulers, the Ancients of Days, as "tyrants and usurpers" and asserted that outside powers had no right to interfere in the affairs of the local universe.

Claim of inherent immortality: he advanced the sophistry that the immortality of personal beings was inherent in themselves and that resurrection was a natural and automatic process, but that outside rulers were suppressing this right to immortality by their arbitrary acts.

③ Attack on the Universal Plan of Ascendant Mortal Training

Criticism of ascension training: he claimed that the long and rigorous universe training program, which trains the humble mortals of evolutionary planets to become universe administrators, was unethical, unsound, and a waste of time.

Ridicule of the finaliter corps: he mocked the finaliter corps on Jerusem, saying that after ages of training they faced the inglorious destiny of being sent back to humble planetary spheres much like those of their origin.

Demand for mortal self-rule: he incited the view that ascending mortals, too, should break free of artificial training and control and enjoy the liberty of individual self-determination.

2. The Nature of the Declaration: "The Robbery of Liberty"

Lucifer wrapped this declaration in the splendid name of "individual freedom and liberation," but in essence it was a robbery of liberty.

Depriving creatures of their right of creative participation: Lucifer sought to take away the divine privilege that the Universal Father had bestowed on mortals and angels, the truly freewill privilege of participating voluntarily, through the long evolutionary process of time and space, in their own immortal destiny and in the development of the system.

License and self-destruction: Luciferian liberty, lacking cosmic reality, moral obligation, and self-control, was not true liberty at all but mere selfishness and self-destroying license.

Immediately after this declaration the administrative cabinet joined in, and thirty-seven Planetary Princes among the 607 inhabited worlds of the system of Satania, including Caligastia, the Planetary Prince of Urantia, went into rebellion, so that the entire system of Satania was swept into a vast spiritual upheaval.

q139.question: What were the deeds of Amadon, the human hero who remained loyal through the seven years of trial during the rebellion on Urantia, and what was the conspiracy of the traitor Caligastia?
q139.answer:
The conspiracy of the traitor Caligastia as described in The Urantia Book, and the deeds of the human hero Amadon, who showed unshakable faith through the seven critical years of trial, are as follows.

1. The Conspiracy of the Traitor Caligastia and the Tragedy of Urantia

Caligastia's standing and his hidden flaw of personality:

Caligastia was a secondary Lanonandek Son (number 9,344), a brilliant spiritual leader who had gained wide administrative experience at the Jerusem system headquarters, in the councils of the Life Carriers, and elsewhere. About five hundred thousand years ago he was sent as Planetary Prince to Urantia, one of the 607 inhabited worlds, where he set up his headquarters at Dalamatia with his staff of one hundred Jerusem ascenders and built up civilization for three hundred thousand years.

Very early, however, he showed an extreme individualistic tendency, resenting the counsel of his superiors and disliking all forms of supervision, and he was given over to a hidden self-pride and sense of self-importance.

The secret advance conspiracy with Satan:

Before the Lucifer rebellion was proclaimed, at a secret conference with Satan, who was visiting Urantia on a routine inspection, Caligastia agreed in advance that as soon as the rebellion was officially announced he would bring the planet Urantia, which he governed, into the betrayal. This was an appalling betrayal of trust toward the creatures who had believed in him and toward the universe government.

Agitation at Dalamatia and the isolation of the planet:

Shortly after Satan's visit, he had Daligastia (his associate) stir up the ten councils of the staff of one hundred, and he proclaimed himself "God of Urantia and supreme sovereign," seeking to seize power. As a result, the system circuits of Urantia were cut off and the planet fell into spiritual quarantine (isolation).

The corruption and destruction of planetary culture and civilization:

Caligastia deliberately and systematically corrupted and distorted the teachings of the planetary schools that had been built up over three hundred thousand years, destroying them in short order. By spreading the sophistry of premature personal liberty among untrained primitive tribes, he plunged society into sudden license and savage racial chaos.

The cunning plot against Adam and Eve:

Although stripped of his sovereignty after the rebellion, Caligastia remained on earth and continued his unlawful activities. Later, when Adam and Eve came as biologic uplifters, he drew even them into a cunning snare through the Nodite leader Serapatatia and Cano, bringing on the tragedy in which Eve defaulted in her biologic mission.

2. The Deeds of Amadon, the Human Hero of the Rebellion

Amadon's origin and identity:

Amadon was a male descendant of Andon and Fonta, the first human twins of Urantia. He was one of the one hundred Andonite descendants who had contributed their life plasm (germ plasm) so that the Prince's corporeal staff of one hundred could have physical bodies with which to function on earth.

He was the personal assistant and human associate of Van, the loyal Lanonandek Son who presided over the supreme court of tribal co-ordination and racial co-operation among the staff of one hundred.

Unwavering loyalty through the seven years of trial:

After Caligastia's declaration of revolt there followed seven bitter years of conflict in which sixty of the staff of one hundred went over to the betrayal and great numbers of higher intelligences, angels and midwayers among them, were deceived.

Amadon, who came from primitive human stock, had no cosmic experience, and was of low intellectual status, was not shaken by the alluring sophistries and pressure of the brilliant Caligastia and Daligastia. Together with Van he held absolutely to his loyalty to the unseen Universal Father and to Michael, the Creator Son.

The wonder and interest of the whole universe (Salvington and Orvonton):

During the seven years of conflict on Urantia, all the way to the headquarters of the local universe of Nebadon (Salvington) and the headquarters of the superuniverse of Orvonton (Uversa), the first question of the countless celestial beings who eagerly read the daily broadcasts was always, "Is Amadon of Urantia still standing firm?"

The unbreakable faith and transcendent devotion shown by a semisavage mortal born of the primitive human stock deeply moved the whole universe.

Guarding the tree of life and preserving the Amadonites:

Together with Van and the loyal angels and midwayers, Amadon guarded the tree of life from Edentia at the risk of his life.

The band of 144 Andonites who remained loyal with him to the end came to be called the Amadonites after his name, and during the spiritual dark ages they served as the biologic and spiritual leaven that kept the lamp of truth on Urantia from going out.

More than 150,000 years of service and the welcome of Adam and Eve:

Sustained by the virtue of the fruit of the tree of life and the ministry of the Melchizedeks, Amadon lived for more than 150,000 years and, with Van, built up some 350 outposts of civilization on earth.

When Adam and Eve at last arrived on Urantia, Amadon, as chairman of the Urantia reception committee of twelve, personally received and welcomed them.

Eternal reward and an example for the corps of finaliters:

Having completed his mission, Amadon was translated (ascended) to Jerusem soon after the arrival of Adam, fused with his indwelling Thought Adjuster, and became an eternal being ascending beyond time and space.

The record of the unflinching Amadon remains an everlasting example, demonstrating to the whole universe how sublime and wise is the Universal Father's universal plan to lead men up from the clay of the humblest mortals on earth and gather them into the eternal Paradise Corps of Mortal Finaliters.

q140.question: What was the course of the Lanonandek Van, who kept faith on Urantia together with Amadon for more than 150,000 years, and what were the origins of the Nodites and of Sumerian civilization, which arose after the rebellion?
q140.answer:
The course of Van over 150,000 years, and the origins of the Nodites and of Sumerian civilization, which arose after the rebellion, are as follows.

1. The Course and Role of the Lanonandek Van

Van was the Lanonandek Son who, among the corporeal staff of one hundred of the Planetary Prince Caligastia, served as chairman of the supreme court of tribal co-ordination and racial co-operation (the tenth council).

His unyielding protest at the time of the rebellion: when the Lucifer rebellion broke out, Van stood against Caligastia's demand for betrayal and, before the council of the staff of one hundred, delivered a historic seven-hour address of protest exposing the sinfulness of the rebellion and appealed to the Most Highs of Edentia.

Seven years of trial and the keeping of loyalty: even when sixty of the staff of one hundred went over to the betrayal and the planetary circuits were isolated, Van, together with thirty-nine loyal members of the staff, his human associate Amadon, and the loyal angels and midwayers, remained loyal to the end to the universe government and to Michael. He also guarded Jerusem's tree of life at the risk of his life.

More than 150,000 years of planetary leadership and preservation: after the fall of Dalamatia, Van led the loyal band to the highlands west of India (around Lake Van and Mount Ararat) and established more than 350 outposts of civilization. Partaking of the fruit of the tree of life, he remained on earth for more than 150,000 years and, co-operating with the Melchizedek receivers of the planet, fostered the natural evolution of mankind.

Preparing the first Garden of Eden and handing over sovereignty: when the coming of Adam and Eve was decided, Van proposed the building of the first Garden of Eden to receive Adam, beginning eighty-three years before his arrival, and the Garden was laid out on a Mediterranean peninsula. When Adam and his mate arrived, Van personally received them and handed over the titular planetary sovereignty he had held for more than 150,000 years.

Ascension to Jerusem and present status: when the Melchizedek receivers withdrew, seven years after Adam's arrival, Van was translated (ascended) to Jerusem together with Amadon and fused eternally with his indwelling Thought Adjuster. He now ministers on Jerusem, the system capital, as one of the Twenty-four Counselors who represent Urantia.

2. The Origin and Formation of the Nodites

The Nodites were the eighth race to appear on Urantia, emerging after the planetary rebellion.

Origin and name: they were born of the union of the sixty rebel members of Caligastia's staff with the forty-four Andonite associates who followed them. The race took its name from Nod, chairman of the Dalamatia commission on industry and trade and the first leader of the rebel staff.

Genetic mutation and superiority: the staff of one hundred originally carried Andonite germ plasm, but under the influence of the life circuits of the system of Satania and the tree of life their genetic chromosome structure had been specially reconstituted. Therefore, when the sixty rebel staff members began sexual reproduction, the first generation of Nodite offspring had mutant traits that made them markedly superior in physical, intellectual, and spiritual capacity to ordinary Andonites or to the Sangik races.

The strife over the tower of Babel and the four Nodite centers: after the fall of Dalamatia the Nodites established a second headquarters at Dilmun, but they were widely dispersed by the civil war connected with the building of the tower of Babel led by Bablot:

West (the Syrian Nodites): they moved to northwestern Mesopotamia and mingled with the Andonites (later ancestors of the Assyrian stock).

East (the Elamite Nodites): they moved to the highlands of Elam and mingled with the Sangik tribes.

Center (the pre-Sumerian Nodites): they settled at the mouths of the Euphrates and Tigris rivers (on the Persian Gulf coast) and preserved their racial purity comparatively well.

North (the Nodite-Amadonites, or Vanites): a loyal group who followed the leadership of Van and Amadon rather than Nod and settled around Lake Van.

3. The Origin and Characteristics of Sumerian Civilization

The Sumerians, regarded as mysterious in history and archaeology, were precisely the fruit that blossomed from the union of this Nodite heritage with the Adamic heritage.

The biological and cultural roots of the Sumerians:

Of the Andites, who were formed when the central pre-Sumerian Nodites remaining near the head of the Persian Gulf later united with the descendants of Adam (the violet race), the small remnant that stayed on to the very last at the mouths of the Mesopotamian rivers were the Sumerians.

They inherited together the Nodites' own Dilmun traditions, the ancient cultural heritage handed down from the days of Dalamatia, and the superior genetic factors and civilization of the Adamites.

Why a mature civilization appeared so suddenly:

When the Sumerians appeared on the horizon of history, they already possessed, without any evolutionary preliminary stages, mature cities, temple architecture, metalworking, irrigated agriculture, pottery, commercial and civil law, religious ceremonials, and a distinctive system of writing. The reason is that they directly inherited the cultural legacy of Dalamatia and Dilmun and of the first and second gardens, accumulated over hundreds of thousands of years.

Their descriptions on clay tablets of Dilmun, the paradise of men and gods, and their records of the strange reigns of early kings lasting thousands of years, reflect later confusion over the longevity of the early Nodite rulers and over their reckoning of time by months (moons).

City-states and their historical end:

Thanks to their high intelligence and their military canal system, the Sumerians long maintained their independence amid the invasions of the northern nomads and were respected as the teachers and administrators of the whole valley.

However, after division and power struggles among the city-states arising from the differences between their city gods (such as the Kish confederation of King Sargon), they were finally absorbed by the northern Semites around 2000 B.C., in the age of Hammurabi, and the history of the Mesopotamian Andites and the Sumerians merged into biblical and secular history.

q141.question: What was the "war in heaven" that Gabriel waged on Jerusem after raising "the banner of Michael" immediately after Lucifer's Declaration of Liberty, and what was the "spiritual quarantine" (isolation) imposed on the system of Satania?
q141.answer:
The details of the "war in heaven" that unfolded on Jerusem, the capital of the system of Satania, immediately after the issuing of Lucifer's Declaration of Liberty, and of the "spiritual quarantine" (isolation) imposed on the entire system of Satania, are as follows.

1. The "War in Heaven" on Jerusem

① Michael's Policy of Noninterference and Gabriel's Command

When the Lucifer rebellion broke out, Christ Michael, the Creator Son, after counsel with his Paradise brother Immanuel, announced that he would take an attitude of noninterference. Since Michael had not yet completed his sevenfold bestowal at that time, he did not intervene by force in the will of creatures. Accordingly, command of his people was entrusted to Gabriel, who proceeded to Jerusem.

② The Banners of the Two Camps (Emblems)

The banner of Michael: on the sphere of Jerusem dedicated to the Universal Father, Gabriel raised the banner of Michael, three azure blue concentric circles on a white background. It symbolizes the universal rule of the deity of the Paradise Trinity.

The banner of Lucifer: Lucifer displayed as his emblem a banner of white with one red circle, in the center of which was a black circle.

③ The Nature of the War: A Great Intellectual and Spiritual Contest

The "war in heaven" was not a barbarous physical sword fight or armed clash.

A contest of ideas and truth: in the administrative amphitheater of Jerusem, Lucifer ceaselessly harangued with sophistries and arguments for the justice of his self-assertion, while Gabriel, from his headquarters nearby, exposed those sophistries with truth and defended the universe government.

A struggle with eternal life at stake: the intelligences of space went back and forth between the two headquarters and, after much deliberation, made their final decisions. Material warfare endangers only the life of the flesh, but this war in heaven, which determined whether each being would survive eternally, was a far more deadly and real war.

④ Manotia, the Second in Command of the Seraphim, and the Loyalty of the Mortals

When the chief of the seraphic hosts on Jerusem went over to Lucifer and many administrative seraphim were led astray, Manotia, the second in command of the seraphim, did not yield to the rebels' destructive schemes but resolutely kept his loyalty to Michael.

In particular, of the ascending mortals then on Jerusem, all 187,432,811 kept their loyalty perfectly; not one of them was taken in by Lucifer's sophistries, which deeply moved the whole universe.

2. The "Spiritual Quarantine" (Isolation) of the System of Satania

① The Immediate Severing of the Spiritual Circuits

As soon as the Lucifer manifesto was issued, the spiritual and communication circuits of the entire system of Satania were immediately cut off by the Constellation Fathers of Norlatiadek and by the supervisor of the tertiary universe circuits (the Andovontia of Nebadon).

② The Specific Features of the Quarantine

Cutting off broadcasts and communication: all the regular spiritual broadcast circuits between planets, between systems, and between constellations were completely cut off. As a result, messages within Satania could be carried only in a limited way, by seraphic transport, by Solitary Messengers, or through the individual channel of the Thought Adjusters indwelling human minds.

Physical circuits maintained: the material gravity and energy circuits under the universe power directors were maintained, but the morontia and spiritual circuits concerned with spiritual development and overcontrol were strictly isolated.

③ The Reasons for the Spiritual Quarantine

Preventing the spread of the poison of rebellion: it was to physically block the sophistries of false liberty and the spiritual contagion from spreading beyond the borders of Satania to neighboring systems or to the whole constellation of Norlatiadek.

Allowing freewill choice to mature: it was to give all creatures within Satania ample time for testing, without outside pressure or hasty suppression by force, so that they might clearly choose, of their own will, between truth and sin.

④ The Prospect of Lifting the Spiritual Quarantine

The arch-rebels of the Lucifer rebellion (Lucifer, Satan, and others) are now confined on the prison worlds of Jerusem.

On the day when the superuniverse courts of Orvonton (the Ancients of Days) hand down the final verdict in the case of "Gabriel vs. Lucifer" and the decree of the rebels' extinction, the spiritual circuits of the entire system of Satania will be fully restored, and the isolated planets, Urantia included, will return to the embrace of the universe family.

q142.question: What will the "era of light and life" look like that Urantia will enter after the system of Satania is restored to the normal circuits, and what is the role of the "Twenty-four Counselors" (the twenty-four elders)?
q142.answer:
The details concerning the era of light and life and the Twenty-four Counselors (the twenty-four elders) are as follows.

1. The Era of Light and Life

The era of light and life is the final and most glorious stage of evolutionary attainment reached by an evolutionary world that has passed through the trials of time and space. After the spiritual quarantine (isolation) caused by the Lucifer rebellion in the system of Satania is fully lifted and the circuits are restored, the glorious features and characteristics of this era through which Urantia will pass are as follows.

① Full Restoration of the Universe Circuits and Cosmic Integration

Restoration of universe broadcasts and communication: the isolated tertiary spirit circuits and the regular broadcast circuits of the local universe and the superuniverse are fully reopened.

Reunion with the great cosmic family: personal intercourse between planets and between systems becomes active, and Urantia is no longer a spiritual orphan of the universe but is fully integrated as an honored member of the whole family of the grand universe.

② The Change from Death to "Translation"

Direct morontia ascension from the life in the flesh: natural physical death is no longer a necessary and inevitable experience for mortals.

The experience of the chariot of fire: spiritually mature, advanced mortals, at the end of their lives, do not pass through the death of the body; in union with their indwelling Thought Adjusters they are translated directly into the morontia state in a "chariot of fire" (a flash of light) and ascend to the first mansion world.

③ The Social and Biological Summit and the Great Unification of Civilization

One language, one religion, one philosophy: all of Urantia is unified in one universal language, one spiritual religion worshiping the one God, and one mature philosophy of rounded harmony (mota).

Complete conquest of disease, degeneracy, and war: through racial improvement and the advance of medicine and biology, disease and mental defectiveness disappear completely, and war and the military machinery vanish into history.

Great lengthening of the life span: the average life span of mortals increases greatly, to from three hundred to five hundred years or more of Urantia time.

④ The Appearance of the Morontia Temple and the Finaliters' Participation in Administration

The settling of the morontia temple on earth: the Paradise finaliters, who have completed the Paradise-Havona ascension, and the Trinity Teacher Sons appear on earth, erect the morontia temple, associate personally with the mortals of earth, and counsel them in cosmic wisdom.

Elevation to Planetary Sovereign: by the decree of the Michael Son, the existing Planetary Prince is elevated to the status of Planetary Sovereign and rules in fatherly fashion over a world like a garden of light.

⑤ The Course of Seven Stages

The era of light and life expands through the following seven stages and moves toward the unification of the whole grand universe:

First (the planetary stage): the stage in which the morontia temple is established and the whole system is settled

Second (the system stage): the system capital and all the inhabited planets settled in light

Third (the constellation stage): the spiritual settling of the entire constellation

Fourth (the local universe stage): the settling of the local universe headquarters and the whole realm in light and life

Fifth (the minor sector stage), sixth (the major sector stage), and seventh (the superuniverse stage)

2. The "Twenty-four Counselors" (the Twenty-four Elders) Assigned to Urantia

The beings recorded in the Revelation of John in the New Testament as the "four and twenty elders" seated round about the throne of God (Revelation 4:4) are the principal members of the Urantia advisory council (the Jerusem advisory council) located on Jerusem, the capital of the system of Satania.

① Identity and the Background of Its Founding

Time of founding: about nineteen hundred years ago, soon after Christ Michael (Jesus) completed his mortal bestowal and resurrection on Urantia and established his full sovereignty over Nebadon, twenty-four seats were formally placed in the center of the angelic residential circles on Jerusem.

Required qualifications: all are outstanding mortals and creatures of Urantia (the earth) origin (with the exception of Machiventa Melchizedek), persons whose leadership was recognized as they passed through their earth lives, the mansion world experience, and citizenship training on Jerusem.

② Role and Authority

Personal representatives of Michael: on Jerusem, under the orders of Michael and Gabriel, they direct, on behalf of the Sovereign Son, the dispensational resurrections (roll calls), the mortal ascension plan, and administrative affairs of Urantia and the system of Satania.

Advisory supervision of the thirty-six isolated worlds of Satania: they serve as the advisory supervisory commission for all thirty-six planets in the system of Satania isolated by the Lucifer rebellion, and they frequently visit those planets.

Sending the resident governor general of Urantia: every hundred years they choose one of the Twenty-four Counselors and send him to earth as the resident governor general, residing directly on Urantia, to co-ordinate superhuman administration. (For example, John the Baptist is the chairman of the Jerusem council, and 1-2-3 the First, the first midwayer, has served as resident governor general.)

③ The Roster of the Twenty-four Counselors (Sixteen Permanent Members + Eight Seats Held in Reserve)

Of the twenty-four seats of the Urantia advisory council, sixteen are permanently filled by great spiritual leaders of Urantia's past, and eight are held in reserve for future ages.

No. 1, Onagar: the master mind of the age before the coming of the Planetary Prince, who led primitive men in the worship of "The Breath Giver."

No. 2, Mansant: the great teacher of the post-Planetary Prince age, who led his fellows in the veneration of "The Great Light."

No. 3, Onamonalonton: the spiritual leader of the red man (the Indians), who led his tribes in the worship of "The Great Spirit."

No. 4, Orlandof: a prince of the blue men, who first brought them to recognize the divinity of "The Supreme Chief."

No. 5, Porshunta: the oracle of the vanished orange race, who taught the worship of "The Great Teacher."

No. 6, Singlangton: the spiritual leader of the yellow men, who rejected polytheism and led them to worship "The One Truth" (God).

No. 7, Fantad: the deliverer of the green race, who led his tribes to the worship of "⟦Q 45:4.9⟧The One Source of Life⟦/Q⟧."

No. 8, Orvonon: the enlightener of the indigo races (the black races), who led them to serve "The God of Gods."

No. 9, Adam: the planetary father of Urantia (a Material Son), who repented after his default, was rehabilitated, and was received into this group.

No. 10, Eve: the mother of the violet race of Urantia (a Material Daughter), who was rehabilitated together with Adam and serves with him.

No. 11, Enoch: the first mortal of Urantia to fuse with the Thought Adjuster during the life in the flesh and ascend.

No. 12, Moses: the leader who emancipated a remnant of the violet race and revived the worship of "The God of Israel" (Yahweh).

No. 13, Elijah: a translated soul of brilliant spiritual achievement in the post-Material Son age.

No. 14, Machiventa Melchizedek: the Melchizedek who made an incarnated bestowal on earth as king of Salem in the days of Abraham; at present the vicegerent Planetary Prince of Urantia.

No. 15, John the Baptist: the forerunner of the earthly mission of Michael (Jesus); at present the chairman of the twenty-four-member advisory council on Jerusem.

No. 16, 1-2-3 the First: the heroic leader of the primary midway creatures who kept their loyalty on the side of Gabriel at the time of the Caligastia rebellion.

Nos. 17-20, open (temporarily filled): held in reserve for future ascending mortals who will come from the present Son age (the postbestowal age).

Nos. 21-24, open (temporarily filled): held in reserve for the teachers of the coming ages of the Magisterial Sons, the Teacher Sons, and light and life.

q143.question: How do the "twelve corps of the master seraphim of planetary supervision," which overcontrol Urantia's spiritual civilization, operate, and what is the role of the "reserve corps of destiny"?
q143.answer:
According to Paper 114 of The Urantia Book (Seraphic Planetary Government), even under the special circumstances of the Lucifer rebellion and planetary isolation, the spiritual civilization and administration of Urantia (the earth) are being precisely and systematically overcontrolled through the twelve corps of master seraphim and the reserve corps of destiny on earth.

1. The Twelve Corps of the Master Seraphim of Planetary Supervision and Their Techniques of Operation

When the first resident governor general arrived on Urantia at the time of Pentecost, he was accompanied by twelve special corps of seraphim, graduates of Seraphington, who carry on the planetary supervision of their respective fields under the focused direction of the resident governor general and under the leadership of the council of seraphic chiefs.

① The Specific List and Roles of the Twelve Corps

Epochal angels: the angels of the current dispensation, who direct the affairs of each generation so that they fit into the great mosaic pattern of their age.

Progress angels: they foster social and civilizational evolution and constantly awaken the inherent progressive trend of creatures.

Religious guardians: called the "⟦Q 114:6.7⟧angels of the churches⟦/Q⟧," they guard the safe transit of the imperishable moral and spiritual values held in old forms into the thought patterns of a new generation.

Angels of nation life: the "⟦Q 114:6.8⟧angels of the trumpets⟦/Q⟧," who overcontrol international relations and the political activities of nations, carrying out the principle that "the Most Highs rule in the kingdoms of men."

Angels of the races: they work for the conservation of the evolutionary races on earth, regardless of their political and religious entanglements, and co-operate with the race commissioners.

Angels of the future: the forecasting angels, who serve as architects designing in advance the better patterns and plans of the new age to come.

Angels of enlightenment: they foster intellectual and moral education and training at the level of the individual, the family, the school, the community, and the nation.

Angels of health: they assist the mortal agencies and institutions that labor for the promotion of health and the prevention of disease.

Home seraphim: they are devoted to the preservation and uplifting of the home, the basic institution of human civilization.

Angels of industry: they stimulate industrial development and improve economic conditions and the conditions of production.

Angels of diversion: they promote the values of wholesome play, humor, and rest and encourage the profitable use of leisure.

Angels of superhuman ministry: the "⟦Q 114:6.16⟧angels of the angels⟦/Q⟧," who minister to all other superhuman spiritual beings sojourning on or visiting the planet.

② The Specific Operating Techniques of the Master Seraphic Corps

Noncoercive influence: the master seraphim do not violate human free will or exercise arbitrary or coercive control.

Manipulation and association of the environment: they manipulate planetary conditions around the domains of voluntary human activity and associate circumstances so as to bring about, indirectly, a favorable influence on particular fields of civilization.

Strengthening ideals and focusing the mind: though they cannot directly inject new concepts into the human mind, they find the higher ideals and values already budding in the human intellect and make their light shine more brightly.

Activating the emergency safety net: against the danger of the collapse of civilization or the extinguishing of spiritual light, they mobilize and maintain the reserve corps of destiny, made up of mortals on earth.

2. The Secret Role of the Reserve Corps of Destiny

The reserve corps of destiny is an emergency liaison and ministry group made up of living men and women, chosen to support on earth the world plans carried forward by the superhuman administrators.

① Composition and Size

On Urantia there are twelve reserve corps of destiny, corresponding one to one to the twelve corps of master seraphim.

They consist of 962 mortals on earth in all (as of that time), who possess self-conscious Thought Adjusters and personal guardians of destiny.

② Conditions and Qualifications for Selection

Outstanding capacity of mind, able to rehearse secretly and unconsciously the special assignments prepared for planetary emergencies.

The will to devote oneself wholeheartedly to particular spiritual, social, or political purposes without human reward or outward recognition.

Moral character that possesses a versatile Thought Adjuster and has attained the higher levels of the cosmic and spiritual circles.

③ The Secret Training Techniques and the Role of the Secondary Midwayers

Unconscious rehearsal: apart from some twenty contact personalities, most members of the reserve corps are entirely unaware that they are an emergency reserve force.

Unconscious training during sleep: while the mortal is asleep or in deep states of mind, unconscious training and rehearsals for preserving information are carried on through the mediation of the indwelling Thought Adjuster, the seraphic guardian, and the secondary midway creatures. (The presentation of the Urantia revelatory papers through materialization in English was likewise made possible through this technique of Adjuster-midwayer-mortal mind contact.)

Transfer of information from Adjuster to Adjuster: when a member of the reserve corps finishes his earth life, the precious planetary emergency information is passed directly from the Adjuster of the dying personality to the Adjuster of a younger successor and so is preserved.

④ Central Mission and Cosmic Significance

A safety valve for evolutionary civilization: the foremost mission of the reserve corps is to prevent the collapse of evolutionary culture or the extinguishing of the light of spiritual truth amid social catastrophes or spiritual dark ages.

Ministry behind the front of history: in ordinary times they remain unseen, but when historic upheavals or emergencies of truth break out, they come forward as the decisive catalysts who bring about the rule of the Most Highs on earth.

q144.question: What is the "cosmic reserve corps," whose members expand their cosmic consciousness and commune with the celestial circuits, and what is the hundred-year administrative procedure of the resident governor general of Urantia?
q144.answer:
The key statements about the existence of the "cosmic reserve corps" and the hundred-year administrative procedure of the "resident governor general," described in Paper 114 of The Urantia Book (Seraphic Planetary Government), are as follows.

1. The Existence of the Cosmic Reserve Corps

Membership: on Urantia (the earth) there exists a "cosmic reserve corps" made up of more than one thousand mortals whose high insight into cosmic citizenship far transcends the limits of their terrestrial abode.

The secrecy of its function: this unique group of human beings expands its cosmic consciousness and communes with the celestial circuits, but according to the revelation, disclosing details about the real nature of its function and work is strictly forbidden.

The distinction from the "reserve corps of destiny":

Whereas the 962 members of the "reserve corps of destiny," who receive training during unconscious sleep to assist the superhuman ministry of the planet, serve as a working liaison network prepared for planetary emergencies, the "cosmic reserve corps" is clearly distinguished as a separate group of over a thousand mortals who possess cosmic insight.

2. The Hundred-Year Administrative Procedure of the Resident Governor General

① The Hundred-Year Term and the Procedure of Appointment

Designation by the Twenty-four Counselors: every one hundred years of Urantia time, the twenty-four planetary supervisors who make up the Jerusem advisory council (ascended mortals, all formerly of Urantia) designate one of their number and send him to Urantia as resident governor general.

Anonymity maintained: because mortals are so prone to venerate and even to deify superhuman leaders and extraordinary compatriots, the personal name of the current resident governor general is withheld from human beings on earth. (At the time the revelation was written, the twentieth resident governor general was serving.)

② Administrative Character and Role

Co-ordinator of superhuman administration: rather than exercising autocratic or arbitrary rule on earth, the resident governor general, acting on behalf of the Twenty-four Counselors, functions as the respected chief co-ordinating supervisor and leader of all the celestial beings working on Urantia (the seraphic hosts, the midway creatures, and others).

A fatherly adviser: he acts as a fatherly adviser rather than a formal ruler, and every day he renders final rulings and decisions on the many questions arising among spiritual beings such as the seraphim and the midwayers.

③ The Daily Consultation Conference

Every morning the supermaterial government of Urantia begins its day's work by holding a conference of consultation under the leadership of the resident governor general.

This daily conference is attended by the resident governor general, the planetary chief of archangels, the Most High observer from Edentia, the supervising supernaphim, the chief of the resident Life Carriers, and visiting high universe Sons, who co-ordinate the routine administrative affairs of the planet.

④ Administrative Direction Through the Cabinet of the Twelve Master Seraphim

The immediate administrative cabinet of the resident governor general is made up of the twelve acting chiefs of the twelve corps of master seraphim of planetary supervision (epochal, progress, religion, nation life, races, future, enlightenment, health, home, industry, diversion, and superhuman ministry), and through this council he overcontrols each field of planetary civilization.

⑤ His Role After the End of His Term

Having completed his hundred-year term, the resident governor general returns to Jerusem, the system capital, sits as a temporary member of the council of Planetary Princes under the System Sovereign of Satania, reports on the progress of Urantia's administration, and serves in an advisory capacity at the system level.
